title: 第5章 不可直视神明第6章 还请放过我
slug: 降临即邪神开局绑架女武神
content_zh:
“怎么回事？！”
“琉璃灯！！你那边到底出什么状况了！！灵钟响了……你听到了没有！是不是有什么东西进来了……”
“琉璃灯！……你……（呲呲的杂音）……你那边的讯号……（呲呲）……”
一瞬间。
信号断了。
整个街道都陷入了漆黑与死寂。
琉璃灯满脸苍白。
城市的塔楼响起了一声声巨大钟鸣。
【咚——咚——咚——】
当钟鸣想到第九声时，她满眼颤抖。
因为那是他们发条城的【灵钟】，是预示着强大灾厄来袭的警钟，而这也意味着此时此刻在她这里，降临了一个超越现实的可怕的存在。
这……
这怎么可能！
那不断拔高的恐怖气息，已经是让她无力站起。
到底是什么！
到底是什么东西来到了这个世界！
但她还是用了自己最后的力气开启了自己的【破妄之瞳】，向着那黑暗的深处望去，她想要看清，那到底是什么，到底是什么东西的降临，会散发出如此恐怖的气息。
但也就是在她望去时。
噗呲——
一声爆炸。

她的双眼直接炸成了一团血雾，鲜血流淌而出。
只是那一瞬，她隐约在那血月映照之下的黑暗中，看到了一个扭曲爬行的身影，带着难以言喻的灾厄气息，降临于世。
恍惚间。
她想起了书上的那句话。
【神，不可直视。】
……
……
“能联系上吗？！到底是怎么回事！”
“我们正在加紧联系，具体情况我们也不太清楚，好像是发条街那边……那边有什么诡异的东西……降临了！”
驱魔师的总部，那些负责与各个驱魔师进行通讯的文员们满脸恐惧和急切。
因为就在刚刚不久，她们还在和琉璃灯闲聊，谁能想到会出现这样的状况。
“你们听清楚了吗？刚才的钟声，一共响了几声？”
一个老者满脸急切道。
其中的一个女孩满脸颤抖，有些恐惧道：
“……一共……一共九声。”
content_en:
"What's going on?!"
"Liu Li Lan!! What happened to you over there!! The spiritual bell rang... did you hear it! Did something come in..."
"Liu Li Lantern!... You... (squeaking noise)... your signal over there... (squeaking)..."
For a moment.
The signal is cut off.
The whole street fell into darkness and dead silence.
Liuli Deng's face was pale.
Great bells rang out from the city's towers.
【咚——咚——咚——】
When Zhong Ming thought of the ninth tone, her eyes trembled.
Because it was the [spiritual bell] of their Clockwork City, a warning bell that heralded the coming of a powerful disaster, and it also meant that at this moment, a terrifying existence that transcended reality had descended on her.
This...
How is this possible!
The ever-increasing aura of terror made her unable to stand up.
What on earth!
What on earth came into this world!
But she still used her last strength to open her [Destroying Eyes of Delusion] and looked into the depths of the darkness. She wanted to see clearly what it was and what kind of thing would come and exude such a terrifying aura.
But that's when she looked.
Poof——
There was an explosion.
Her eyes exploded into a ball of blood mist, and blood flowed out.
But at that moment, she vaguely saw a twisted and crawling figure in the darkness illuminated by the blood moon, descending into the world with an aura of unspeakable disaster.
In a trance.
She remembered the sentence in the book.
[God cannot be looked directly at. 】
…
…
"Can we get in touch?! What's going on!"
"We are intensifying contact. We don't know the specific situation. It seems that there is something weird over there on Clockwork Street... coming!"
At the exorcist's headquarters, the clerks responsible for communicating with each exorcist were full of fear and eagerness.
Because not long ago, they were still chatting with Liuli Deng. Who could have imagined that such a situation would occur.
"Did you hear clearly? How many times did the bell ring just now?"
An old man said eagerly.
One of the girls was trembling with fear and said:
"...a total of...nine sounds in total."
